question: The Satyagraha Sabha was founded in February 1919 by:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi** founded the Satyagraha Sabha in February 1919.
 
• The Satyagraha Sabha was established in response to the **Rowlatt Act**, which allowed the British colonial government to imprison any person suspected of terrorism without trial.
 
• Gandhi initiated the Satyagraha movement as a form of non-violent resistance against the oppressive policies of the British government.
 
• The Sabha aimed to mobilize Indians to engage in non-violent protests and civil disobedience to demand the repeal of the Rowlatt Act.
 
• This movement marked an important phase in India's struggle for independence, emphasizing the power of non-violent protest.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi**, also known as Mahatma Gandhi, is regarded as the leader of the Indian independence movement against British rule.
 
• He is known for his philosophy of **non-violence (Ahimsa)** and his strategy of **Satyagraha**, which means "truth force" or "soul force".
 
• Gandhi's leadership and methods of peaceful protest inspired many other movements for civil rights and freedom across the world.
 
• He played a crucial role in various other significant movements in India such as the **Non-Cooperation Movement**, the **Civil Disobedience Movement**, and the **Quit India Movement**.
 
• Gandhi's birthday, October 2nd, is commemorated as **Gandhi Jayanti** in India and is also observed as the **International Day of Non-Violence**.
